observations.note: Top surface is well-lit and fully visible; several fine scratches and scuff marks are present across the panel. Edges and corners appear intact.
Panel shown vertically with slight perspective; scratches and scuffs remain visible. No edge chipping observed.
Perspective view shows the same scratch/scuff pattern; surface contrast is sufficient to identify linear marks. No material loss seen.
Opposite perspective view confirms scratches on the left and central areas. Borders and corners look continuous.
Vertical view of the panel shows lower and middle scratches clearly; no evidence of coating or edge loss.

limitations: Only the visible top/front surface is inspected; rear, sides, and internal structure are not shown.
Shallow scratches and low-contrast smudges may be partially masked by surface reflection or lighting.
No scale, depth, or dimensional information is available from the images.
